about.title: The island, in full colour
about.dek: A premium magazine of property, culture and the good life across Cyprus.
body: Cyprus Lifestyle is the record of how the island lives, invests and enjoys itself at the top end. Cyprus sits where Europe, the Levant and the Gulf meet, and this is the publication of that crossroads — glamorous like the fashion books, authoritative like the great living titles, and multilingual by birth.

We publish in seven languages: English as the international lead, Greek as the home edition, Arabic for the Gulf, and Romanian, Russian, German and Polish for the resident and investor communities that make Cyprus what it is. Every canonical story is translated across all seven, right-to-left for the Arabic edition.

Our desks cover Cyprus and politics, business and investment, property and architecture, culture and heritage, escapes and the sea, and the Cypriot table. Restraint reads as expensive; specifics read as true.

advertise.title: Advertise with Cyprus Lifestyle
advertise.dek: Reach the quarter of Cyprus that was born elsewhere — investors, relocators and high-spending visitors — in seven languages, from €49 a month.
body: One in four people in Cyprus today was born somewhere else. They are relocating, buying homes, opening companies and spending well — and they choose where to eat, stay and buy in English, Greek, Russian, Arabic, Romanian, Polish and German. Cyprus Lifestyle is the one title that reaches them in all seven, in a single, considered place.

Put your business on the map our readers search, let our editors write a feature about it, sponsor the section your customers live in, or take the Saturday newsletter. Every placement runs across all seven editions — translation included, because that is simply how we publish.

We are opening partnerships to the first 100 businesses at founding rates: a fraction of our published price, locked for as long as you stay. A verified listing is €149 for the year; the full Featured presence is €49 a month. Choose a placement below, or tell us about your brand and we will send the one-page media kit. Prices exclude VAT.

privacy.title: Privacy
body: Cyprus Lifestyle collects the minimum necessary to run the publication: the email address you give us to receive the newsletter, and anonymous, aggregated analytics about how the site is read. We do not sell personal data.

You can unsubscribe from the newsletter at any time using the link in every email. To request deletion of your data, contact us through the contact page. This notice is a starting point; please have it reviewed by counsel before launch and adapt it to GDPR and Cypriot law.

standards.title: Editorial Standards
standards.dek: How Cyprus Lifestyle is reported, written, translated and corrected.
body: Cyprus Lifestyle is editorially independent. Our coverage is not for sale; sponsored features are always labelled as such, and commercial relationships never determine what we cover or how.
We report from named desks and value specifics over adjectives. Where a story draws on another publication or a primary document, we say so and link to the source.

We use AI tools to help gather, draft and translate — but every canonical story is edited by a person before it publishes, and each of our seven editions (English, Greek, Romanian, Arabic, German, Polish and Russian) is reviewed for accuracy and tone, right-to-left for the Arabic edition.
We correct mistakes promptly and visibly. If something is wrong, write to us through the contact page and we will put it right.

whenToVisit.title: When to visit Cyprus
whenToVisit.intro: Warm, dry and swimmable for half the year. Here's the island month by month — day temperature, sea temperature, and whether it's beach weather.
whenToVisit.best: The sea is warmest in August and September, but May, June, October and early November are gloriously swimmable with lighter crowds. Winter is mild and green — made for exploring more than for the beach; evenings from October cool quickly, so pack a light jacket.
